contextNotes.TunnelersJersey_Name: Tunnelers is a named Zuzu City sports team. Establish nominative Тунелерси, genitive Тунелерса; preserve canonical град Зузу with Serbian inflection.
contextNotes.NavyTuxedo_Name: Navy denotes the dark-blue color here, not naval service.
contextNotes.GreenThumbShirt_Name: Green thumb is gardening skill; use Баштованска and preserve the potting-soil joke rather than inventing a literal thumb motif.
contextNotes.SportsShirt_Description: The baseball expression knock it out of the park praises the wearer's appearance. Adapt to sporting success without implying a gameplay bonus.
contextNotes.ShirtOTheSea_Name: The contracted O' marks nautical flavor; use морски вукови in the garment name and retain the literal briny smell in its description.
contextNotes.YobaShirt_Description: The source names a religious sign of the vessel; сасуд denotes the receptacle in the symbol's name, not a boat or an item ID. Retain quotation and do not add an explanation absent from English.
